senses.zh_definition: 若原文指人名，则为 Rory，通常音译为“罗里”；当前材料不足以确定该小写词项的实际所指。
senses.en_definition: Conditionally identified as the personal name Rory; the intended meaning of the supplied lowercase token remains unverified.
senses.ms_definition: Jika merujuk kepada nama orang, bentuk ini ialah nama khas Rory; makna token asal belum dapat dipastikan tanpa konteks.
senses.nuances: 这是有条件的人名分析，不是已核实的马来语普通名词释义。人名 Rory 的存在不能证明本批次中的 rory 必然指该名字。以下为自拟人名用例，搭配仅示范组合，不标称高频。未取得可支持 official 状态的词典证据。

etymology.historical_story: If the token denotes the personal name Rory, its history belongs to Gaelic naming traditions rather than Malay derivation. The Scottish National Dictionary connects Rory with Gaelic forms including Ruairidh and Ruaidhri. This establishes a history for the name, but does not identify the unexplained token in the supplied packet. [Scottish National Dictionary](https://dsl.ac.uk/entry/snd/rory)
